summary: - **[AIDASoft/podio#1082](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1082)** — RNTupleReader reads only the fields of requested collections and caches per-file views, making reading roughly 5x faster; RNTuple support requires ROOT 6.34 or newer.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1080](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1080)** — Doxygen documentation of podio-generated EDMs hides podio internal classes by default via a PODIO_INTERNAL conditional section; downstream projects must opt in to keep them documented.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1083](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1083)** — MurmurHash3 functions move into the podio::detail namespace and file-local helpers are no longer exported, preventing global symbol clashes with other libraries bundling MurmurHash3 (see also **key4hep/EDM4hep#559**).

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#447](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/447)** — OverlayTiming adds background SimCalorimeterHit contribution energies to merged hits and keeps whole hits when any contribution falls in the time window, changing overlay calorimeter output.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#452](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/452)** — Writer deletes the store wrappers of collections registered via the legacy DataHandle, fixing a 1.8 kB per-event memory leak that reached gigabytes in long k4SimDelphesAlg jobs.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#172](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/172)** — Framework input conversion changes EDM4hep MCParticle times from ns to mm/c, correcting production, track and calorimeter timing in k4SimDelphesAlg, which was too small by a factor c.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/171)** — k4SimDelphesAlg fills its RecoMCLink collection, linking reconstructed particles to the external generator MCParticles and providing reco-to-truth associations that were empty in Gaudi-based Delphes workflows.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#417](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/417)** — IDEA and CLD Delphes cards set RandomSeed to 0 so each job draws a fresh seed, avoiding identical detector smearing sequences across production jobs.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#414](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/414)** — The IDEA Delphes card is synced with upstream Delphes, adding dual-readout photon angular smearing; EDM4hep output adds JetDurhamN2 and GenMissingET. The card requires Delphes 3.5.2pre02.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#682](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/682)** — IDEA o2 HCAL endcap hits encode cell IDs using the endcap metadata rather than the barrel one, fixing cell ID decoding for the DRTubes calorimeter endcap simulation.
